guidance.1: Trivial — single obvious change; ~1 hour with AI
guidance.2: Simple — localized change, clear path; ~2 hours
guidance.4: Moderate — a few files or a small flow; ~4 hours
guidance.8: Substantial — multi-surface or non-trivial logic; ~8 hours
guidance.16: Complex — several interconnected pieces or tricky edge cases; ~16 hours
guidance.32: Heavy — broad refactor or deep investigation; ~32 hours; prefer splitting
guidance.64: Epic complexity — many unknowns or cross-cutting systems; ~64 hours; almost always split

notes: Tech team currently has Todo (unstarted) and Backlog; Triage is preferred when the team enables it. Always assign to me and link to Project One unless the user overrides.
